charts.title: HD 219134 c: orbits around HD 219134
charts.description: The orbits of HD 219134's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 219134 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 6.7650398 d

charts.title: HD 219134 c: its transit
charts.description: HD 219134 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (57, 77, 84) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 283722336, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
